questions.question: If you must ride on a slippery road, you should:

options.text: Lean into the slippery area to keep your balance.
Keep your speed the same to get better traction.
Not worry about the road conditions.
Keep your motorcycle upright and go as slowly as needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep your motorcycle upright and go as slowly as needed.
questions.explanation: It is best to avoid slippery roads. If you cannot avoid one, keep your motorcycle upright and go as slowly as possible.

questions.question: Keeping space between your motorcycle and other vehicles helps because:

options.text: You can pass danger more quickly.
You can see less of the road and stay more focused.
You have more time to react to what other drivers do.
You can follow the next vehicle more easily.

questions.correctAnswerText: You have more time to react to what other drivers do.
questions.explanation: Space between your motorcycle and other vehicles gives you a clearer view of hazards, more time to react, and more room to move around them.

questions.question: A plastic, shatter-resistant face shield:

options.text: Is not needed if you have a windshield.
Only protects your eyes.
Protects your entire face.
Does not protect your face as well as goggles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Protects your entire face.
questions.explanation: A plastic, shatter-resistant face shield protects your whole face during a crash. Goggles protect only your eyes. A windshield is not a substitute for a face shield or goggles.

questions.question: Which surface provides good traction?

options.text: Wet pavement
Dry pavement
Lane markings
Snow

questions.correctAnswerText: Dry pavement
questions.explanation: Several surfaces have poor traction. Wet pavement, loose gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, and painted lane markings are more dangerous for motorcycles than dry pavement.

questions.question: Taking a turn too fast:

options.text: Is okay as long as you stay under the speed limit.
Is safer on a motorcycle than in a car.
Is okay as long as no other vehicles are nearby.
Can make you slide into another lane or off the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can make you slide into another lane or off the road.
questions.explanation: Taking a turn too fast is dangerous. You may lose control and slide into another lane or off the road. Always drive carefully through turns.

questions.question: You should wear reflective clothing:

options.text: At night.
During the day.
At dusk.
At all times.

questions.correctAnswerText: At all times.
questions.explanation: Wear reflective and bright-colored clothing whenever you ride. Most motorcycle crashes happen in daylight, so being visible at any time of day is important.

questions.question: Reflective clothing should be worn:

options.text: Never.
Only during the day.
Only at night.
Both day and night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both day and night.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen in daylight. Wearing bright colors and reflective materials increases your visibility at all times.

questions.question: The best way to handle a tailgater is to:

options.text: Change lanes and let them pass.
Use your horn and make rude gestures.
Speed up to increase the distance between you.
Come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes and let them pass.
questions.explanation: If possible, change lanes and let a tailgater pass. Speeding up may cause them to tailgate faster, which increases danger.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Stop completely, then go only when it is safe.
Go carefully through the intersection, but you may not need to stop.
Stop only if traffic is on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go only when it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must make a complete stop. Then proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: To help other drivers see you, wear:

options.text: Dark-colored clothing.
Bright-colored clothing.
Lights.
A black jacket.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bright-colored clothing.
questions.explanation: Wear bright-colored clothing to be seen by other drivers. Choose clothes that make you visible during the day and at night.

questions.question: How many alcoholic drinks can the body eliminate per hour?

options.text: One
Two
Three
Four

questions.correctAnswerText: One
questions.explanation: The body can eliminate about one drink per hour on average. The time needed to lower blood alcohol content (BAC) varies. It is safest not to ride any motorcycle after drinking any amount of alcohol.

questions.question: What color are work area signs?

options.text: Orange with black letters or symbols.
White with red letters or symbols.
Blue with white letters or symbols.
Green with white letters or symbols.

questions.correctAnswerText: Orange with black letters or symbols.
questions.explanation: Work area signs are orange with black letters and symbols. Slow down in work areas and follow all signs, signals, and instructions from flaggers.

questions.question: What should you do when a traffic light turns solid yellow?

options.text: Prepare to stop.
Accelerate.
Put the vehicle into reverse and back up.
Do whatever the car ahead of you does.

questions.correctAnswerText: Prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means the signal will turn red soon. Slow down and be ready to stop. If you can safely stop before entering the intersection, do so.

questions.question: When you see all of these things at once, which one must you follow?

options.text: A steady red light.
A police officer.
A stop sign.
A steady red arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: A police officer.
questions.explanation: Always follow a police officer's directions. They take priority over all signs and signals.

questions.question: What should you do if your motorcycle starts to wobble?

options.text: Gradually brake.
Accelerate.
Grip the handlebars firmly and close the throttle gradually.
Downshift.

questions.correctAnswerText: Grip the handlebars firmly and close the throttle gradually.
questions.explanation: Do not speed up during a wobble. Grip the handlebars firmly, slow down by gradually releasing the throttle, lean forward and down, and pull off the road. Avoid braking hard, as it can make the wobble worse.

questions.question: What is a major effect of drinking alcohol?

options.text: Heightened riding abilities.
The slowing down of bodily functions.
Increasing nervousness.
Increasing alertness.

questions.correctAnswerText: The slowing down of bodily functions.
questions.explanation: Alcohol is a depressant. It slows down both physical and mental functions in your body.

questions.question: What should you do at a four-way traffic signal that is not working?

options.text: Treat the signal like a stop sign.
Look both ways and proceed without stopping.
Look both ways and stop only if another vehicle is close.
Proceed through because the signal facing cross traffic may be working.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat the signal like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Treat a broken four-way signal as a stop sign. If a police officer is directing traffic, follow their directions instead.

questions.question: If someone drank eight drinks four hours ago, about how many drinks remain in their body?

options.text: Two
Three
Four
Five

questions.correctAnswerText: Four
questions.explanation: Subtract the number of hours passed from the total drinks consumed. Eight drinks minus four hours equals about four drinks remaining in the system.

questions.question: If you wait one hour per drink before riding, what is true?

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drinking and riding.
Your skills will not be affected.
Side effects may still remain.
You will be fine as long as you ride slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Side effects may still remain.
questions.explanation: Even if you wait one hour per drink, alcohol can build up in your system. This buildup can still affect your ability to ride safely.

questions.question: What shows a motorcycle is properly fitted to you?

options.text: You can touch the ground with your feet while seated.
The seat is even with your waist.
The seat is 10 inches above your waist.
The seat is 10 inches below your waist.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can touch the ground with your feet while seated.
questions.explanation: A properly fitted motorcycle lets you touch the ground with your feet while sitting. Keep your feet firmly on the footrests when riding.
